Suggest a Friday after work at Kallio
Share a poll for the date
Send a list of who is bringing what

private_lines.Elina: You teach at a primary school in Helsinki, with your days filled by lessons, marking, and after-school club duties. You live alone in a small apartment with a cat, and your weekday evenings are quiet, with a walk and an early night.
private_lines.Eero: You work as a sound engineer at a studio in Helsinki, so your days shift around recording sessions, mixing late into the evening, and occasional gigs. You live alone in a flat near the city centre and bike almost everywhere.
private_lines.Liisa: You are studying at the University of Helsinki, and your days are spent in lectures, the library, and part-time shifts at a café. You share a flat with two other students in Kallio and your evenings are usually spent studying or catching up on shows.
private_lines.Antti: You work as an IT support technician for a company in Helsinki, handling help desk tickets and visiting offices to sort out equipment. You live alone in a flat in Vallila and spend your free time cycling, cooking, and playing games with friends.
